title: Kando Martial Arts Knox
name: Paul F
text:
⸻

Kando Knox is an amazing club to be a part of. Before joining, I took my kids to two other places, but they just didn’t connect. As soon as you walk into Kando, you feel a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The staff are friendly and inclusive from the moment you arrive, and the kids are given uniforms straight away so they feel comfortable and part of the group.

The teachers are the standout. They do an incredible job with young children, making classes engaging, fun, and full of positive energy. The kids respond to it and really enjoy being there. At the end of each class, they take a moment to talk with the kids about important values, such as being kind to others and listening to their parents.

It’s genuinely a wonderful environment. I highly recommend going down and getting involved – we’re so glad we found this place.

title: Kando Martial Arts Knox
name: Sam Horwood
text:
I want to highlight an important aspect of what is great about Kando to help answer the question: “why should I send my kids here?”
Answer: Role models.
It’s not just that Andy, Sonya and the Kando team are really thoughtful role models, modelling behaviours, values and ethics that we want for all kids to be upstanding members of society. It is also that kids get to learn how to be good role models themselves from other kids of higher belts (who have an ability to help out with lower belts classes through the leadership program), and from the adult instructors too. In addition to the many physical benefits of the martial arts sport, the very deliberate program that Kando has teaches kids respectful values, leadership, empathic helping, patience, mental resilience, confidence by overcoming fear and much more.
If you’re looking for a sport for your kids, I encourage you to consider a trial at Kando, and see this for yourself, as it’s much more than just kicking and punching.

Through the practice of these disciplines, kids develop not only physical skills but also a sense of accomplishment and confidence.
